review.notes: Full review. Of the 9 findings of the previous round, 8 are repaired and the locator finding partly. New: P2, 3.1 defines the action of a derivation on the Hochschild chains of A, which do not compute the derived HH of Convention 1 when A is not k-flat (witness F_2[x] over Z); P3, 3.1, 5.4, 5.5 and 5.1's definition cite a work without a numbered locator; P3, the module docstring gives cyclic homology as the missing carrier of 4.5, which lacks normalised forms. Gate OK on my run (all counters 0), depcheck 0 problems, Suggested.lean elaborates with five sorry warnings only, 20 one-tactic probes close nothing, 7 signatures compared. Sampled locators read in Loday-Quillen (rendered pages), Kassel-Loday, Cuntz-Quillen 1995a/b, Cortinas, Connes' book and Quillen 1996 (GDZ, OCR); 12 cross-roadmap citations resolved; adversarial table of 20 rows with values. Goodwillie 1985, Marin 1998, Gonzalez-Ferez-Marin 2007 and Wodzicki 1989 are paywalled and listed under Not verifiable.
